name: Verify episodic .bak release
goal: Confirm restarting the 4 Claude sessions released the deleted 39 GiB db.sqlite.bak and record the result.

tasks.name: Check release and record (V1-V4)
tasks.description: No tests required: two read-only checks + doc append. Exact commands: human plan Task 1 Steps 1-4. stderr to own .err; NOTHING killed/changed.

steps.command: cd /private/tmp/disk-shortfall && lsof +L1 > verify-lsof-L1.txt 2> verify-lsof-L1.err; echo "lsof=$?"; grep -F db.sqlite.bak verify-lsof-L1.txt; echo "bak-holders-grep=$?"
steps.expected: bak-holders-grep=1 (none). If 0: record each remaining PID's chain via ps -o pid=,ppid=,lstart=,tty=,command= -p <pid> repeated on PPID until 1.

steps.command: cd /private/tmp/disk-shortfall && df -h /System/Volumes/Data > verify-df.txt 2> verify-df.err; echo "df=$?"; cat df.txt verify-df.txt
steps.expected: Avail now vs 207Gi in df.txt; measured delta recorded; ~+39 GiB confirms release.

steps.description: V3: append '## 7. Release check (2026-10-12)' to docs/reviews/2026-10-12-disk-shortfall-findings.md: bak-holders-grep result (+ remaining holders if any), Avail before/after and delta, whether 39 GiB came back; cite verify-lsof-L1.txt and verify-df.txt; non-~39 delta reported as measured, no guessed cause
